verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a TypeScript auth framework, since libraries and CLIs can ship usage tracking. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any documented opt-out mechanism. Community remarks about owning auth data in your own database concern data residency, not telemetry, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
